name: RogueDelve
purpose: A simple single-screen browser roguelike: procedurally generated dungeon levels, turn-based movement, lootable items, normal and special monsters, a definite end goal, and a kills-based top-scorer leaderboard.
actors: Player (guest, plays runs in the browser, name recorded at run end)

entities.name: Game
relationships: has player state (hp, attack, position, inventory, kills, score)

entities.name: Level
relationships: has a generated grid of tiles (wall/floor/stairs)
has Monsters and Items placed on floor tiles

entities.name: Monster
relationships: is normal or special (elite/boss) with scaled stats
moves toward player on player turns

entities.name: Item
relationships: lootable on walk-over (healing potion, attack/defense buff, key)

entities.name: ScoreEntry
relationships: records player name, kills, score, depth reached, result (won/dead), created_at

workflows.name: Start a run
workflows.description: Player enters a name and starts a new game; dungeon level 1 generates with player, monsters, items, and stairs.

workflows.name: Move and fight
workflows.description: Arrow/WASD moves the player turn by turn; stepping onto a monster attacks it; monsters take a turn after the player.

workflows.name: Loot items
workflows.description: Walking over an item picks it up; potions heal, tomes buff attack, shields buff defense; inventory is shown.

workflows.name: Descend
workflows.description: Walking onto stairs descends to the next generated level, deeper and harder.

workflows.name: Reach the goal and end the game
workflows.description: Reaching the goal depth (defeating the final boss / claiming the artifact at depth 5) ends the run as a win; dying ends it as death; either way the run records a score entry.

workflows.name: View leaderboard
workflows.description: Top scorers ranked by kills, showing name, kills, depth, score, and result.

seed_demo: A few sample ScoreEntries so the leaderboard is populated before anyone plays, and a fresh starter run demonstrating level 1 generation.
